buyer_question: What customer data does the AI feature process?
evidence_source_to_attach: Data-flow diagram; retention position; approved customer-data classes; subprocessor list
safe_answer_boundary: Do not say customer data is never used unless the mapped flow and exceptions support that exact scope.

buyer_question: Is customer data used to train or improve models?
evidence_source_to_attach: Training-use position; model provider terms; customer opt-out or contractual records
safe_answer_boundary: State only the approved training-use position and mark any region, product or contract exceptions.

buyer_question: How do you monitor accuracy, hallucination or unsafe output?
evidence_source_to_attach: Evaluation notes; known limitations; human-review rule; rollback route; monitored failure examples
safe_answer_boundary: Do not claim the system is accurate, hallucination-free or risk-free without test scope and limitation language.

buyer_question: What access controls protect the system?
evidence_source_to_attach: Access-control policy; SSO/MFA notes; logging path; vulnerability-management process; incident contact
safe_answer_boundary: Do not copy generic control language that is not tied to the deployed service and owner.

buyer_question: Are you certified or compliant with a named framework?
evidence_source_to_attach: Policy index; certification evidence if available; adviser-reviewed statements; region-specific scope
safe_answer_boundary: Do not imply certification, regulatory approval or legal advice that has not been obtained.

buyer_question: What customer results or ROI can you prove?
evidence_source_to_attach: Approved case-study policy; demo/simulated labels; measurement window; guarantee terms if any
safe_answer_boundary: Do not claim revenue lift, rankings, savings or customer outcomes without verified proof.

buyer_question: Who owns uptime, changes and renewal evidence?
evidence_source_to_attach: Admin owner; change approval route; monitoring cadence; renewal owner; buyer escalation path
safe_answer_boundary: Do not promise support, SLA, uptime or managed-service scope unless it is contracted and owned.

buyer_question: Can this answer be sent to the buyer?
evidence_source_to_attach: Named approver; approved answer; expiry date; blocked-items register
safe_answer_boundary: Block any answer without a source, owner, status, limitation and review date.
